_note: Championship Manager 01/02 databases read by pipeline.cm0102. Key: folder under FEL_INPUTS/cm0102. s = real season start year; dy = stored year minus real year (the CM 01/02 engine starts in 2001, so later or earlier seasons are stored shifted). Shifts were measured as the modal birth-year difference against Wikidata for players of ability 120+ (cm89 0, cm93 0, cm95 0, cm3 +3, original 0, april -19, october -20; 2026-10-07). One database per season: the patched copies, luessenhoff (a second 2001-02) and november (an earlier 2020-21) are not listed.
